programmes.d: Hillary asks Frank and Santana for help in a lawsuit involving defective aircraft parts.
Hunter and McCall's investigation of the stabbing of a deaf man hinges on cryptic clues the victim gave in sign language before he died.
The wife of a businessman who was killed in an explosion on his yacht becomes the prime suspect when Hunter and McCall discover that she was recently removed from his will.
Hunter and McCall investigate the whereabouts of four million dollars still missing from a six-year-old drug bust that implicates the police in criminal activity.
New evidence in the case of a murdered friend brings Tony and Paulie back to their Brooklyn neighborhood.
While trying to help an elderly woman recover her lost life savings, Tony learns Rachel may have cancer.
Paulie fights to prove that a homeless teenager isn't a murderer.

After serving a false rap to establish his “wiseguy” credentials, undercover FBI agent Vinnie Terranova infiltrates the criminal underground of Atlantic City, where he could wind up dead with one slip of his cover.
In an attempt to take over Sonny Steelgrave's business, mob head Paul Patrice frames Sonny for several murder attempts he makes on the life of a special prosecutor.
A psychopathic murderer posing as Sonny's nephew double-crosses Sonny and holds Vinnie's girlfriend Gina hostage.
